title: Terminal capability detection and colour tiers
goal: One module decides, once at startup, what the terminal can do (colour tier, unicode, size, background, env opt-outs) so every TUI component degrades the same way.
scope_in: `detectCapabilities(env, stdout, stdin)` returning an immutable `TermCaps` using the tier rules of DESIGN §19.3: truecolor (`COLORTERM=truecolor|24bit`), 256 (`TERM` contains `256color`), 16 (otherwise), none (`NO_COLOR` set, not a TTY, or `TERM=dumb`).
Unicode support flag (UTF-8 locale from `LC_ALL`/`LC_CTYPE`/`LANG`, false for `TERM=linux`), half-block capability (unicode and tier is not `none`), hyperlink and bracketed-paste capability flags.
Async `queryBackground(io, timeoutMs=150)`: OSC 11 query (`ESC ] 11 ; ? BEL`), parse `rgb:RRRR/GGGG/BBBB`, return `dark` or `light` by relative luminance < 0.5, `unknown` on timeout or non-TTY.
Env opt-outs parsed into typed values: `CENTO_MASCOT=on|off`, `CENTO_REDUCE_MOTION=1`, `CENTO_SPINNER=fun|plain`, `CENTO_THEME=dark|light|auto`.

Size helpers: `watchSize(stdout, cb)` (debounced 50 ms) and `layoutClass(cols, rows)` returning `ok` (>= 80x24), `narrow` (< 80 cols), `short` (< 24 rows), `tiny` (< 40 cols or < 10 rows); `mascotAllowed(caps)` encoding §10.1.9 (>= 80 cols, >= 30 rows, not `CENTO_MASCOT=off`).
scope_out: Mapping tokens to colours and ANSI output (lane C032).
Drawing the mascot or any fallback art (lane C033).
Persisted user settings and the `/theme` and `/mascot` commands (lane C047); this lane only reads the environment.
Screen-reader mode detection (lane C049 adds its flag on top of `TermCaps`).
build_against: Pure function tests with synthetic env objects and fake streams (EventEmitter with `isTTY`, `columns`, `rows`); the OSC 11 query is tested against a scripted fake TTY from lane C008.
interfaces: `interface TermCaps { tier: ColorTier; unicode: boolean; isTTY: boolean; cols: number; rows: number; halfBlock: boolean; hyperlinks: boolean; bracketedPaste: boolean; mascotEnv: 'on'|'off'|'auto'; reduceMotionEnv: boolean; spinnerEnv: 'fun'|'plain'|'auto'; themeEnv: 'dark'|'light'|'auto' }`
`detectCapabilities(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, out: NodeJS.WriteStream, inp?: NodeJS.ReadStream): TermCaps`
`queryBackground(io: {out: NodeJS.WriteStream; inp: NodeJS.ReadStream}, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<'dark'|'light'|'unknown'>`
`layoutClass(cols: number, rows: number): 'ok'|'narrow'|'short'|'tiny'`; `mascotAllowed(caps: TermCaps): boolean`; `watchSize(out, cb): () => void`
acceptance: Table test of 20 env combinations: `COLORTERM=truecolor` -> truecolor; `TERM=xterm-256color` without COLORTERM -> 256; `TERM=xterm` -> 16; `NO_COLOR=1` with COLORTERM=truecolor -> none; `NO_COLOR=` (empty) -> colour allowed per the no-color.org rule (empty means unset); stdout not a TTY -> none; `TERM=dumb` -> none.
`LANG=C` or `TERM=linux` gives `unicode:false` and `halfBlock:false`; `LANG=en_US.UTF-8` gives both true when tier is not none.

`queryBackground` resolves `dark` for `rgb:0707/0909/1a1a`, `light` for `rgb:f3f3/f6f6/ffff`, and `unknown` after 150 ms (+/-20 ms) when no reply arrives; the reply bytes are consumed and never reach the prompt input.
`queryBackground` writes nothing when stdout is not a TTY and returns `unknown` immediately.
`mascotAllowed` is false at 80x24 (needs 30 rows), true at 80x30, false at 120x40 with `CENTO_MASCOT=off`.
`watchSize` coalesces 10 resize events within 50 ms into one callback with the final size, and the returned disposer removes the listener.
Invalid env values (`CENTO_THEME=purple`) fall back to `auto` and report the problem through the returned `warnings` array, never throw.
tests: terminal/osc11.test.ts: reply parsing (4-digit and 2-digit hex channels), timeout, non-TTY, reply swallowed.
guardrails: MUST honour `NO_COLOR` above every other signal (truecolor env, user theme setting) per DESIGN §19.3.
MUST NOT emit any escape sequence (including the OSC 11 query) when stdout or stdin is not a TTY, and MUST NOT leave stdin in raw mode after the query.
MUST bound the OSC 11 wait to 150 ms; startup must not stall on terminals that ignore the query.
MUST be a pure function of its inputs (no reading `process.env` directly), so tests are deterministic.
MUST NOT cache capabilities across a terminal resize beyond `cols`/`rows`; colour tier is detected once, size is live.
failure_modes: Terminal replies to OSC 11 late (after the timeout) -> the late bytes are discarded by a one-shot input filter that expires after 500 ms; they must not be typed into the prompt.
Stream has no `columns` (piped) -> default to 80x24 and `isTTY:false`.
notes: Windows: treat `WT_SESSION` as truecolor-capable; this is an implementation detail not in DESIGN §19.3, record it in the README. FORCE_COLOR is not in the design system; do not add it without a design decision.
